abstract_class_config.class_description: E2A base for SAP BOPF Ledger BO — double-entry financial posting, idempotency, saga participant contract

generator.user_prompt: Generate a LedgerPostingAgent that extends BaseLedgerAgent. It is a Kafka saga participant: consumes SettlementInitiatedEvent, performs double-entry ledger posting (one DEBIT + one CREDIT per settlement) in a single @Transactional operation, enforces DB-level idempotency via UNIQUE INDEX on (settlement_id, direction, entry_type), publishes LEDGER_UPDATED event on success, and posts reversal entries on SettlementFailedEvent compensation. Implements SAP BOPF Ledger BO double-entry accounting invariant.
generator.system_prompt_additions: NFR: DoubleEntryLedgerInvariant, TransactionalIdempotency, SagaParticipantCompensation, AtLeastOnceKafkaConsumer, OptimisticLockingViaVersionAnnotation
